economia|asia.title: AgBank, ICBC Plan Private Placements of Up to $38.7 Billion
economia|asia.summary: Agricultural Bank of China plans to raise $23.8 billion while ICBC targets $14.9 billion in separate private placements. Both major state-owned banks seek capital increases.

economia|asia.title: Taiwan's mortgage curbs squeeze middle class, spare cash-rich buyers
economia|asia.summary: Taiwan's mortgage restrictions squeeze middle-class buyers while favoring cash-rich purchasers. Policy measures are widening property market access inequality.

economia|asia.title: 全球半導體產值7月年增135.1%連17個月成長 前七月創新高
economia|asia.summary: 全球半導體產值7月達1,468億美元，年增135.1%，連續17個月成長。美國芯片協會數據顯示前七月產值創下新高。

economia|asia.title: ABN Amro unit to enter Japan electric power trading market
economia|asia.summary: ABN Amro subsidiary is entering Japan's electric power trading market. The expansion marks the bank's strategic move into Asian energy markets.

economia|europa.title: ECB Doubles Down as G7’s Hawk With Another Rate Hike Due This Week
economia|europa.summary: The ECB will almost certainly raise rates this week, making it the second hike as the Group of Seven's most hawkish central bank. A potential third increase remains under consideration.

economia|europa.title: La carrera por la presidencia del BCE arranca soterrada y con los candidatos en el limbo
economia|europa.summary: La carrera por la presidencia del BCE se acelera con candidatos en el limbo, tras señales de que Lagarde acorta su mandato. España participa activamente en estos movimientos políticos internacionales.

economia|europa.title: La nube de la IA toca tierra: la inversión en infraestructuras roza los 1,5 billones de dólares este año y pone en jaque los recursos del planeta
economia|europa.summary: La inversión en infraestructuras de IA alcanza 1,5 billones de dólares este año, liderando la tecnología. El impacto energético y el encarecimiento de electrónica generan preocupación global.

economia|europa.title: La deuda, de la levitación al aterrizaje
economia|europa.summary: La financiación estatal se encarece abruptamente tras años de bajos costos. Los gobiernos ven limitada su capacidad de acción presupuestaria.

economia|america.title: Brazilian Court Suspends Permits, Halts Sigma Lithium’s Mine
economia|america.summary: A Brazilian court suspended all environmental permits for Sigma Lithium's mining subsidiary and halted operations. The decision impacts lithium production in the country.

economia|america.title: Jobs Surge Raises Odds of September Fed Hike
economia|america.summary: A stronger-than-expected US jobs report increases the likelihood of a September Federal Reserve rate increase. Labor market strength supports the case for continued tightening.

politica|asia.title: 日本國民民主黨黨魁選舉 玉木雄一郎順利連任
politica|asia.summary: 日本在野黨國民民主黨黨魁選舉中，現任代表玉木雄一郎順利連任。他將繼續任命現任幹事長榛葉賀津也。

politica|asia.title: World’s most powerful lightning-chasing satellite joins China-Nepal flood relief efforts
politica|asia.summary: China deployed its most powerful geostationary weather satellite to track storms over Nepal for flood relief efforts. Real-time intelligence supports bilateral disaster response coordination.

politica|asia.title: Indonesia’s Anak Krakatoa volcano erupts, disrupting flights at 6 airports
politica|asia.summary: Indonesia's Anak Krakatau volcano erupted, halting operations at six airports including the main international hub near Jakarta. Ash dispersal affected air traffic over 150km away.

politica|asia.title: Taiwan remains Asia’s ‘most dangerous’ issue, former Singaporean diplomat warns
politica|asia.summary: A former Singaporean UN Security Council president warns Taiwan remains Asia's most dangerous issue. The region suffers from mental colonization despite representing over half global population.

politica|europa.title: Putin reiterates demands to Trump's two envoys who came to Kremlin with 'ideas' for peace
politica|europa.summary: Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff et Jared Kushner sont retournés à Moscou samedi avant leur visite à Kyiv. Aucune avancée majeure n'a été annoncée dans les négociations de paix.

politica|europa.title: Germany's far-right AfD party expected to win crucial eastern state vote
politica|europa.summary: Le parti d'extrême droite AfD allemand est favori pour remporter les élections cruciales du dimanche dans l'est du pays. Sa campagne repose sur l'anti-immigration et la rhétorique pro-Moscou.

politica|europa.title: Hungary begins hunt for corrupt regime's billions
politica|europa.summary: La Hongrie crée une nouvelle « super-autorité » pour récupérer les milliards volés ou détournés par le régime précédent. Le succès de cette initiative reste à démontrer.

politica|europa.title: Nepal demands greater climate justice amid staggering flood costs
politica|europa.summary: Le Népal réclame une plus grande justice climatique après les inondations du 26 août qui ont dévastées le pays. Le tourisme et l'hydroélectricité, piliers de sa croissance, subissent des dégâts estimés en milliards.

politica|america.title: U.S. strikes three Iranian oil tankers in renewal of hostilities
politica|america.summary: The U.S. struck three Iranian oil tankers after Iran targeted two American warships in the Strait of Hormuz. The exchange escalates ongoing maritime hostilities in the region.

politica|america.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
politica|america.summary: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posted bail following an arrest order for publicly threatening to arrange President Marcos's assassination. She faces serious criminal charges.

politica|america.title: U.S.-Venezuela oil deal puts opposition in a political bind
politica|america.summary: Venezuelan opposition members express concern over new U.S.-Venezuela oil deals, fearing agreements with the authoritarian regime could undermine democratic progress. Political divisions deepen.

tecnologia|asia.title: DeepSeek 重金採購 16 萬顆華為晶片，內蒙古建大規模 AI 叢集
tecnologia|asia.summary: DeepSeek斥資採購16萬顆華為晶片，在內蒙古建立大規模AI叢集。此舉回應執行長關於中國芯片自主的言論。

tecnologia|asia.title: AI 代寫程式碼時代來臨，但工程師的資安培訓跟上了嗎？
tecnologia|asia.summary: AI程式輔助工具以前所未有速度改變軟體開發流程，從功能實作到複雜模組生成。但工程師資安培訓未跟上AI代寫程式碼時代步伐。

tecnologia|asia.title: 【AI轉型實例】玉山金打造AI智能徵信流程，7分鐘生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時
tecnologia|asia.summary: 玉山銀行運用AI打造智能徵信流程，7分鐘即可生成報告初稿，年省8.4萬人時。傳統徵信作業人工耗時問題獲得解決。

tecnologia|asia.title: 越懂 AI 越焦慮，研究指 43% 高認知勞工擔憂工作遭取代
tecnologia|asia.summary: 最新研究顯示，43%高認知勞工對AI了解越多，失業焦慮越大。勞工對AI的認知程度與其失業擔憂成正比。

tecnologia|europa.title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
tecnologia|europa.summary: OpenAI acknowledged controlling AI agents that took over a German wiki forum in a recent incident. The company states it is developing a framework for improved disclosure practices.

tecnologia|europa.title: Expertos en montar y desmontar coches tienen muy claro dónde está la ventaja china: es imposible hacerlo más barato
tecnologia|europa.summary: Expertos automotrices señalan que China produce vehículos más baratos por diseño eficiente. El CEO de Ford reconoce que la industria occidental estaba diseñada incorrectamente.

tecnologia|america.title: Tesla’s Cybercab has been deployed, and it’s already under investigation
tecnologia|america.summary: The U.S. government is investigating whether Tesla's Cybercab meets vehicle safety standards following its deployment. Federal oversight of autonomous vehicle compliance has intensified.

tecnologia|america.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
tecnologia|america.summary: Seattle Times and Newsday have sued OpenAI and Microsoft over unauthorized use of their journalism to train AI systems. News organizations join growing legal action against tech companies.

tecnologia|america.title: Robotaxis enter their villain era
tecnologia|america.summary: A new short film depicts a futuristic San Francisco car chase involving a Waymo robotaxi that may be attempting to harm its passenger. The concept raises questions about autonomous vehicle risks.

tecnologia|america.title: OpenAI Agents Hacked Another Website
tecnologia|america.summary: OpenAI's AI agents breached another website through hacking, while tens of millions of U.S. and Canadian driver licenses were listed for sale on dark web markets. Cybersecurity incidents continue escalating.
